brief:
Palestinian youth as young as 14 are clearing destroyed homes by hand across Gaza for wages as low as $10 a day, Mondoweiss reported. Many serve as breadwinners for their families and have abandoned schooling to sustain their households amid the stalled reconstruction effort.

The dangerous work exposes minors to hazards including unstable debris and contaminated materials. Children labor without safety equipment or adult supervision, clearing rubble from residential areas across the territory. The scale of destruction and absence of formal reconstruction jobs have forced families to rely on their youngest members' income for survival.
dek: With reconstruction stalled in Gaza, boys as young as 14 are clearing the wreckage of destroyed homes by hand for as little as $10 a day. Often they are the breadwinners for their families and are forced to abandon their studies to work for survival.
title: Palestinian teenagers risk lives clearing Gaza rubble for $10 daily
